title: Episode 5
summary: The goalie for a women's football team is found shot dead in the changeroom.
method: The victim was shot earlier, before the game, by accident when the killer was trying to take the gun away from her for safety. They are all friends and the fear of being charged for various crimes (manslaughter, possession of a weapon, supplying a weapon) led them to cover up the crime by bandaging the victim's leg and removing the bullet from the wall. Removing the bandages caused extreme blood loss leading to her death. The gun and bandages were thrown in the laundry, which were already taken away when the team began investigating.
motive: The killer was trying to take the gun away from the victim for safety reasons and it went off accidentally.
killer: The victim's friend, a backup goalie
